commands.result: All five author test groups passed independently, including actual QEMU execution, Rust encoder and clang/lld comparisons.

Five independent target modes executed. Missing first LABEL, first LABEL 2 and an infinitely recursive value-struct layout were incorrectly accepted and emitted ELF. Control wrap exits 0 and aggregate ABI program exits 97.

findings.problem: function() allows a first non-LABEL instruction through its at!=1 exception and never requires LABEL 1. Both malformed streams produce a successful new ELF, violating the explicit H3 typed-IR entry-block contract.
findings.required_change: Require the first IR instruction to be LABEL 1; preserve full block terminator/unique-definition/reference validation. Add both missing-label and different-first-label rejection tests.

findings.problem: layouts() verifies only local size equations; a struct with one field of its own type at offset 0 and claimed size 0/alignment 1 passes. This is an infinite value type, so the backend is accepting a non-complete type despite the H3 malformed-IR validation contract.
findings.required_change: Reject cycles through value layout dependencies while permitting pointer/slice indirection. Verify direct and mutual value cycles plus a legal self-pointer case; do not rely on front-end input being well-formed for this backend contract.

verified_contracts: Actual target implementation emits RV64 executable code and ELF without host assembler/compiler involvement in production emission.
Valid aggregate hidden-result/stack-argument ABI, snapshots, arithmetic panic/wrapping, ABS64/BSS, large constants, and all B2 .s0 opcode/long-transfer reference comparisons passed.
Existing malformed slot/pointer/call/return/label/type, frame bound and link data overlap/undefined-symbol rejection tests passed.
limitations: M1 not accepted; F and I must not treat this candidate as accepted.
Other capacity totals/behavior/source-differential/self-compilation evidence remain final I obligations.
